parameters.help_en:
The conditions for searching assets. This parameter is in JSON format. Pay attention to letter case when you specify this parameter.
You can search for assets by instance ID, instance name, VPC ID, region, or public IP address. Call the [DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~) operation to query the supported search conditions
parameters.help_zh:
设置搜索资产的条件。该参数JSON格式，输入参数时注意大小写。
支持使用资产的实例ID、实例名称、所属VPC ID、地域、公网IP地址等条件搜索资产。您可以调用[DescribeCriteria](~~DescribeCriteria~~)接口查询支持的搜索条件
parameters.name: criteria

parameters.help_en:
The logical relationship among multiple search conditions. Default value: OR. Valid values:
OR: The search conditions are evaluated using a logical OR.
AND: The search conditions are evaluated using a logical AND
parameters.help_zh:
设置多个搜索条件间生效的逻辑关系。默认OR，取值：
OR：表示多个条件间为或的关系。
AND：表示多个条件间为与的关系
parameters.name: logical_exp

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to bind all assets. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: Bind all assets.
false: Do not bind all assets
parameters.help_zh:
是否全量绑定。默认false，取值：

true：是
false：否
parameters.name: bind_all

parameters.help_en:
The authorization version of the asset. Valid values:
6: Anti-virus Edition.
5: Premium Edition.
3: Enterprise Edition.
7: Ultimate Edition.
10: Value-added service Edition
parameters.help_zh:
资产的授权版本。取值：
6：防病毒版
5：高级版
3：企业版
7：旗舰版
10：增值服务版
parameters.name: auth_version

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic binding. Valid values:

0: Disable automatic binding.
1: Enable automatic binding
parameters.help_zh:
开启自动绑定。取值：

0：关闭
1：开启
parameters.name: auto_bind

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether this is a pre-binding operation. Valid values:

0: No.
1: Yes.


After pre-binding is enabled, the corresponding authorization quota is automatically bound to the specified servers after the purchase is completed
parameters.help_zh:
是否预绑定操作。取值：

0：否
1：是


开启预绑定后，会在完成购买后自动为指定服务器绑定对应版本的授权数
parameters.name: is_pre_bind

parameters.help_en: The order ID associated with the pre-binding operation
parameters.help_zh: 预绑定关联的订单编号
parameters.name: pre_bind_order_id

parameters.help_en:
The order version associated with the pre-binding operation. Valid values:

level7: Anti-virus Edition.
level3: Premium Edition.
level2: Enterprise Edition.
level8: Ultimate Edition.
level10: Value-added service only
parameters.help_zh:
预绑定关联的订单版本。取值：

level7：防病毒版
level3：高级版
level2：企业版
level8：旗舰版
level10：仅采购增值服务
parameters.name: ntm_version

parameters.help_en:
The collection of UUIDs to bind.

Bind and UnBind cannot both be empty
parameters.help_zh:
绑定的UUID集合。

Bind和UnBind不能同时为空
parameters.name: bind

parameters.help_en:
The collection of UUIDs to unbind.
Bind and UnBind cannot both be empty
parameters.help_zh:
解绑的UUID集合。
Bind和UnBind不能同时为空
parameters.name: un_bind

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts (Alibaba Cloud account) in the resource directory.
Call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Use a different token for each request. The token supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端 Token，用于保证请求幂等性。不同请求应使用不同的 Token；只支持 ASCII 字符，长度不超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

BindCount.description_en: The number of servers that are successfully bound

InsufficientCoreCount.description_en: The number of cores for which the authorization quota is insufficient
InsufficientCoreCount.description_zh: 授权核数授权数不足的数量

InsufficientEcsCount.description_en: The number of servers for which the authorization quota is insufficient
InsufficientEcsCount.description_zh: 授权服务器授权数不足的数量

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

ResultCode.description_en:
The status code of the binding result. Valid values:

0: Succeeded.
1: Parameter error.
2: Insufficient server authorization quota.
3: Insufficient server core authorization quota
ResultCode.description_zh:
绑定结果状态码。取值：

0：成功
1：参数错误
2：缺少服务器授权数
3：缺少服务器授权核数

UnBindCount.description_en: The number of servers that are successfully unbound
